message.content:
In December, Los Angeles enjoys mild, Mediterranean‑style weather. Typical averages are:

| Metric | Approximate value |
|--------|-------------------|
| **Average high** | ~18 °C (≈64 °F) |
| **Average low** | ~10 °C (≈50 °F) |
| **Daily mean (average)** | ~14 °C (≈57 °F) |

So if you’re looking for a single “average temperature” figure, you can round it to about **14 °C (57 °F)** for the month. The city rarely sees temperatures below freezing, and daytime highs are usually comfortable for outdoor activities.
